pr.title: gh-111178: fix UBSan failures in `Modules/itertoolsmodule.c`
pr.body:
This PR fixes the UBSan failures and addresses some minor cosmetic changes. PEP-7 changes were not applied since they could scramble the diff but other semantic changes affecting the signature of touched functions may have been done.

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-111178 -->
* Issue: gh-111178
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

review_comments.body:
Don't remove this cast. `Py_VISIT` is documented to take `PyObject *`. In practice it works with anything and we're not likely to change that, but `PyObject *` is the correct type here.
```suggestion
    Py_VISIT((PyObject *)to->dataobj);
```

Isn't it already a PyObject? (maybe not but I can't look at it now easily)

Edit: my bad it's not. Thanks for catching this.
